```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)


data("weather_df")

```

Now we have everything we need! 

Start with a scatterplot

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temprature (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temperature (C)",
    y = "Min Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA for three weather stations"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-10, 0, 15),
    labels = c("-10 c", "0", "Fifteen")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "sqrt",
    position = "right"
  )
```

Let's look at color !!! 
```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_hue(h = c(100, 300)) 
```

```{r}
weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
    name = "Location",
    discrete = TRUE
  )
```
